name: pi-theme-switcher · Packages · Pi
description: The extension polls every 60 seconds to handle time-based transitions during long TUI sessions. It does not run in RPC, print, or JSON sessions where no terminal TUI theme can be changed. Create a config file at ~/.pi/agent/theme-switcher.json (global) or .pi/agent/theme-switcher.json ...
